description: This Java configuration class sets up a batch job named 'GenerateRdScheduleJob' within the Fineract platform. It defines beans for a step and a job, utilizing Spring Batch components, and configures dependencies like data source, transaction management, security context, and service interfaces. The primary purpose is to facilitate the scheduled generation of RD (Recurring Deposit) schedules in the savings portfolio module.

classes.name: GenerateRdScheduleConfig
classes.description: Java configuration class that defines beans for a batch job to generate recurring deposit schedules in the Fineract platform, utilizing Spring Batch and dependency injection for necessary services.

methods.name: generateRdScheduleStep
methods.description: Defines a Spring Batch Step object that executes the 'generateRdScheduleTasklet' as a tasklet within a transaction.

methods.name: generateRdScheduleJob
methods.description: Defines a Spring Batch Job object that starts with the 'generateRdScheduleStep' step and uses a RunIdIncrementer for job instance identification.

methods.name: generateRdScheduleTasklet
methods.description: Creates an instance of GenerateRdScheduleTasklet, injecting required dependencies such as the data source factory, deposit account service, and security context.
